evidence.quote: As such, I am prepared to act by raising rates, if necessary.
Thinking first of the price-stability side of our mandate, my assessment is simple: Inflation is too high.
Taken together, these developments have shifted the balance of risks toward inflation and away from the labor market.
If I do not see signs of continued disinflation soon, I am prepared to act.
I view the U.S. economy as remaining resilient and growing at a solid pace.
Thus, while we might be able to afford to wait for longer in a different environment, we do not have that luxury in this one.

This is tempered by support for holding rates steady for now and the expectation that tariff, oil and AI-related price pressures will ease.
